findings.evidence: When visiting RestaurantNews.com, the IP address used to access the site will be logged along with the dates and times of access. This information is purely used to analyze trends, administer the site, track users movement and gather broad demographic information for internal use.
findings.rationale: The policy discloses that IP addresses are logged but does not specify that they are shared with Google AdMob. The purpose of logging IP addresses is unspecified.
